remarks: Delightfully updated North Stamford ranch in sought-after convenient location aims to please! The slate walkway & front porch welcome you to a home with newly refinished hardwood flooring, sparkling white kitchen with new appliances, designer backsplash + quartz countertops, 2 fresh & stylish full baths + a finished, walk-out lower level featuring new luxury vinyl floors, woodburning fireplace and an abundance of possibilities! You'll equally enjoy the outdoor space, the entertainer's back deck overlooks the level fenced yard, and even more relaxing is the separate Zen space featuring Koi Pond, gardens and seating area. Newly installed central a/c, natural gas heating and attached 2-car garage complete this idyllic package. Come see!
